carryon_allowance.value: 2 pieces per passenger (infants excluded): one cabin bag, laptop bag, handbag or small bag, in any combination of two
carryon_allowance.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.6.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Cabin bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm (must fit the overhead bin); second bag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm (must fit under the seat)
carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.6.

carryon_weight.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.6: "The total permitted weight for the two (2) pieces must not exceed 7kg."

allowance.value: Not included in the fare: checked baggage is bought as an add-on, at a discounted rate when booking or up to 4 hours before departure, and at the full rate at the airport counter
allowance.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.5. Weight steps and rates are in AirAsia's Fee Schedule and are not recorded here.

excess_baggage.value: Baggage over the weight bought in advance is charged per kg at the airport check-in counter; the fee is non-refundable
excess_baggage.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.5.

max_piece.value: No single item over 32 kg, or over 81 cm high, 119 cm wide and 119 cm deep, is accepted
max_piece.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 8.5 (mobility equipment excepted).

fare_name.notes: The FD conditions of carriage do not name the entry fare. Needs a reading of AirAsia's own fare-type page.

seat_selection_included.value: No particular seat is guaranteed; a seat is allocated at check-in unless an advance seat is bought
seat_selection_included.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Articles 5.8 and 5.8.1.

change_cancellation_policy.value: Bookings cannot be cancelled or refunded once confirmed. Flight changes are allowed only more than 48 hours before departure, for a fee plus any fare difference; route changes are not allowed
change_cancellation_policy.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Articles 5.1 and 5.3. Article 5.4 says the change rules do not apply to certain promotional fares.

online_checkin.notes: The FD conditions (Article 6.1.2) refer to the website for self check-in and give no window.

domestic_cutoff.value: 45 minutes before departure (60 minutes at KLIA2)
domestic_cutoff.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 6.1.1; counters open 2 hours before domestic flights.

international_cutoff.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 6.1.1; counters open 3 hours before international flights.

boarding_close.value: Be at the gate 30 minutes before departure; boarding closes 20 minutes before, and this may vary by country or airport
boarding_close.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 6.2.1.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

rebooking_refund.value: On international routes, when Thai AirAsia cancels or reschedules a flight it offers, at its discretion, a free move to the next flight with space, the fare held as credit for 90 days, or a refund
rebooking_refund.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 9.2.1. Domestic routes follow Thailand's Ministry of Transport passenger-rights announcement (B.E. 2553) and CAB Regulation No. 101 (Article 9.2.2).

delay_refund_threshold.value: On international routes, a refund applies when the cancellation or reschedule is 3 hours or more from the original departure time; not for changes made at the airport on the day of departure
delay_refund_threshold.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026), Article 9.2.1.

duty_of_care_policy.notes: The FD conditions defer to Thai regulations for care during delays and state no figures. Do not infer from the regulation text.

customer_service.notes: The FD conditions of carriage name no customer-service channel.

phone_home_market.notes: No phone number is published in the FD conditions of carriage. Do not add a number from any other site.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: Terms and conditions of carriage for FD flights (last update 8 Jun 2026).

official_website_url.notes: AirAsia passenger website, which sells FD flights.
